## Content checklist (skip if this is code only)

- [ ] `validate-pack` passes for the pack(s) I touched.
- [ ] The questions are in my own words. Nothing is copied from exams, books, courses or other question banks.
- [ ] `source` is honest: `hand` if I wrote it, `ai` if a tool helped.
- [ ] New items are `reviewed: false`. The maintainer sets `true` after checking them against a source.
- [ ] Where a fact could be disputed, the item has `references`.
- [ ] If I changed an item that was `reviewed: true`, I set it back to `false`.
